description: This file contains a top-level script that runs upon import, checking for the presence of certain key files and directories to determine if the current directory is the root of a Flutter project. It defines a final boolean 'rootCheck' that executes this check and outputs guidance messages if the expected project structure is missing.

methods.name: rootCheck
methods.description: A final boolean variable initialized with a function that performs project structure checks and outputs guidance messages if the checks fail.
